# AI Doctor Study
> AI-powered study companion for MBBS and medical students

## What it is
AI Doctor Study helps medical students study smarter using AI. Ask any medical question and get instant expert explanations.

## Features
- AI Q&A: Ask any medical topic, get doctor-level explanations
- Image Analysis: Upload X-rays, slides, diagrams for AI analysis
- Clinical Cases: Practice with real clinical scenarios
- Drug Mnemonics: AI-generated memory aids for pharmacology
- Exam Prep: MBBS, USMLE, PLAB focused preparation
- Flashcards: Unlimited AI-generated flashcards

## Pricing
- Free plan: 20 questions/day, basic subjects, standard AI
- Pro plan: $2.99/month, unlimited questions, all subjects, image analysis, clinical cases, drug mnemonics, USMLE/PLAB prep, flashcards
- Student discount: code MED20 for 20% off Pro
